page_title: ALA 0-0 ATM | Alaves v Atletico Madrid 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
90+3' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90+2' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The current number of corner kicks is 3:5.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carles Alena trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
88' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
86' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
85' Kike Garcia (Alaves) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Jan Oblak's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
84' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.

83' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. It will be a corner kick for Atl. Madrid.
81' Koke (Atl. Madrid) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
80' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Wonderful movement by Atl. Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
78' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
77' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
77' The ball is cleared after Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
76' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
76' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

75' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
75' The total number of attempts is 7:4.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
74' Kike Garcia (Alaves) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
72' That's the end of the game for Conor Gallagher, who is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
72' Pablo Barrios comes off the pitch to be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
72' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Jon Guridi will be replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
72' Joan Jordan (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ander Guevara.
71' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top left corner, but Antonio Sivera has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
70' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
68' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
67' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
66' Atl. Madrid take a short corner kick.

66' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
65' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
64' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
63' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) receives a yellow card.
63' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez signals a set piece.
63' One of the Alaves players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
62' Kike Garcia (Alaves) plays a through ball but overhits it.
61' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
60' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) replacing Giuliano Simeone.
59' The game has come to an end for Antoine Griezmann. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
58' Lovely cross from Manu Sanchez to find Carlos Vicente (Alaves) deep in the box, but he steers his header well wide of the right post.

57' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
56' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
56' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Martinez no option but to blow his whistle.
54' The free kick picks out Jon Guridi (Alaves) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
53' It's a free kick to Alaves in a dangerous position.

51' Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Manu Sanchez was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
51' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Alaves are taking a throw-in.
50' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

48' Kike Garcia (Alaves) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
48' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Martinez starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+5' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
45+3' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' 10:5 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
42' Confusion here but it seems that referee Juan Martinez has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) to a yellow.

42' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
41' Although Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) is just on the bench, Juan Martinez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
41' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is being sent off by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier!
41' Juan Martinez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
40' A clumsy foul by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) and Juan Martinez blows his whistle.
39' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' An attempted cross from Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
37' Some neat passing and movement from Atl. Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
36' The match can continue after the interruption.
34' The game is interrupted.
31' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) probably handled the ball. Alaves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
28' Ander Guevara (Alaves) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' Ander Guevara (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
28' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
27' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.

26' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Julian Alvarez attempts to score after getting on the end of it. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Giuliano Simeone.
24' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
23' Rough tackle by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.

22' A through ball from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach Conor Gallagher as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Conor Gallagher could have got into a promising position.
21' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 38:62.
20' Atl. Madrid are seeing far more of the ball now.
19' Juan Martinez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carles Alena (Alaves).
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
16' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' The game is interrupted now, Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul during an attacking move.
14' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
13' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez blows for a foul.
11' None of the Atl. Madrid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
11' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
10' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Antoine Griezmann, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
9' The game is interrupted as Kike Garcia (Alaves) is flagged offside.
7' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Jon Guridi (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
6' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
5' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
4' Atl. Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Jon Guridi (Alaves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Martinez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
1' The first half has started.
Alaves will kick-off.
Juan Martinez was nominated as the referee for this game.
